lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Hi Carmen, this is Yolanda. Is this an okay time to talk?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Hey, yeah, I was waiting for your call.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Great. So today I'd like to hear how the band exercises went, check how you're feeling, and pick a goal for next week. Anything you want to add?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: That works.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: How's your body feeling this week?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Pretty good actually.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Okay, good.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Tell me how the band exercises went this week.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: It didn't happen this week.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What do you think the next step should be?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I don't know, honestly.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Where could the band exercises fit in your day?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Got it.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I need to get my sugar down.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What's worked for you before?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Well, if I plan it the night before, I can do it.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Whatever you pick is fine with me. It's your plan.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Do you think 5 days is realistic?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Not yet.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Do you mind if I tell you what some people do?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Sure.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: A lot of people do the band exercises while they watch TV. It makes it feel like less of a chore.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I feel better about myself when I stick to it.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Your family is a big part of why.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I'm going to do it Monday, Wednesday and Friday.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You know your schedule better than anyone.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What could you try instead?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Hmm, I have to think about that.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You're open to it. You just want it to fit your real life.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I can do the band while I watch my novela. My daughter keeps reminding me.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You've got a plan in mind already.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I already told my family about my goal. My grandson thinks it's funny that I have a step counter.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Would it be okay if I shared something that's helped other people?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Sure.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: A lot of people do the band exercises while they watch TV. It makes it feel like less of a chore.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: My diabetes is why I'm doing this. Church on Sunday always throws me off.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: It's completely your call.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Part of you is already moving, and you want to keep that going.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I have to do something, I don't want the cancer back.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: How do you want to handle the band exercises going forward?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Okay, this week I'll really do it.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: This is about more than the band exercises. It's about getting your life back.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I'll set an alarm on my phone.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You've made up your mind.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I put a reminder on the fridge.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: It's completely your call.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You want to be around and be well for the people you love.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You're weighing it up, and that's fair.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Right.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You'd rather start small and actually stick with it.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I can probably manage three days.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: It's completely your call.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You're starting to see that small changes add up.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I already told my family about my goal.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Is that something you can do?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yes. I'm going to do it Monday, Wednesday and Friday.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What could you try instead?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I mean, I know I can do it, I did it before.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You know your schedule better than anyone.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: So what would you like your goal to be for next week?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Let's say I do the band exercises 3 times.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: On a scale of 0 to 10, how confident are you that you can do that?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Like a 8.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Why a 8 and not a 5?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: My arms feel stronger already.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What might get in the way?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I'll ask my son to come with me.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: So, to sum up: being so tired made this week harder, you still got 0 days in, and your plan is to do the band exercises 3 times. Sound right?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yes. You got it.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Same time next Monday?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: That works.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Okay Carmen, have a good rest of your day.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Thank you, talk soon.

flags.reason: Pushes a reframe ('getting your life back') without permission after she voiced her own reasons.
Says tiredness made the week harder and reports '0 days in'; she never mentioned tiredness and the summary omits her own reasons.
Repeats the exact TV-exercise suggestion from line 22 after she moved on, ignoring her reply.
Strong motivation ('I don't want the cancer back') met with a generic autonomy line instead of exploration.
'I need to get my sugar down' was not explored; coach moved on without asking what that means to her.

score.summary: Coach used good open questions and let Carmen build her own plan, including a 3-day goal and a confidence rating of 8. However, the coach repeated the same advice, pushed a reframe, and gave a summary with details Carmen never said, and missed her change talk about diabetes and cancer recurrence.
strengths: Line 17 and line 38: clear autonomy stance that let Carmen choose her plan.
Line 29 and line 39: complex reflections captured her openness and her wish to keep moving.
Line 64-68: confidence scaling followed by 'Why a 8' drew out her own strengths (line 67) and barriers (line 69).
coaching_tips: Line 22 and line 35 repeat the same TV suggestion; after permission, offer it once and then ask what she thinks of it.
Line 40 ('I don't want the cancer back'): explore this motivation with a reflection and a question such as 'What would staying well look like for you?'
Line 43: replace the reframe with a question or reflection, since it pushed a meaning she had not expressed.
Line 70: check the summary against her words; she never mentioned tiredness and said she did it before, so ask 'Did I get that right?'
Line 54 and line 47 repeat 'It's completely your call' as a stock phrase; vary it with reflection of her reasons.
